thread:
olivia: Heads-up — code freeze for v1.12.0 RC goes into effect at 17:00 UTC today. Please finish outstanding PRs or file a late-merge exception. If you request an exception, include: 1) short risk summary, 2) test verification, and 3) owner + rollback plan. I'll be triaging exceptions starting 15:30 UTC. Thanks!
kevin: @olivia quick q — I have a docs + package.json version bump for the telemetry feature. Docs-only + changelog entry. Safe to squeeze in?
maya: release manager chiming in — docs-only + changelog entries are usually OK if small. @kevin paste the PR link and the changelog snippet here.
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4892
Changelog snippet:
- telemetry: add user-level sampling configuration (kevin)
I'll bump package.json from 1.11.4 -> 1.12.0 in the same PR.
sanjay: one quick question — do we need to re-run e2e for this? docs-only should skip heavy tests right?
maya: @sanjay for docs-only we still need unit + lint + static checks. E2E can be waived as long as there are no infra/behavior changes. I'll mark the exception accordingly.
release-bot: Reminder: Code freeze starts in 30m (17:00 UTC). Submit late-merge requests in #eng-releases if needed.
kevin: Ok creating the PR now. I'll add `changelog-owner: @kevin` to the PR body and point to docs/CHANGELOG.md.
kevin: Quick note on the version bump I'm running locally (copying for reviewers):
```
jq '.version="1.12.0"' package.json > tmp && mv tmp package.json
git add package.json docs/CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m "chore: v1.12.0 changelog + docs"
```
maya: @kevin please include a short validation summary in the PR — e.g. rendered md screenshot or a link to the preview. I'll review and then approve. :+1:
deploy-bot: CI queued: platform/unit-tests #12345 — Status: pending
olivia: Exception approved for PR #4892 — docs + changelog only and unit/lint checks passed. @kevin please do NOT add any additional changes to that PR. Marking as late-merge allowed. :tada:
kevin: Thanks all — merging in 5m and pinging ops if anything flaps. :shipit:
